name: claude-launcher-minimal
description: One status bar button per Claude profile — each opens `claude agents` in the current project's folder, as a pinned terminal tab.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted folders, the folder's own settings can't change your profiles, skip permissions, auto-open agents, or turn on cross-profile messaging.

commands.title: Claude: New Agents Tab for Profile…
Claude: Open Live Chat for Profile…

claudeLauncher.dangerouslySkipPermission.description: Launch with `claude agents --dangerously-skip-permissions`, bypassing Claude Code's permission prompts. Turn off to get prompted as usual.

claudeLauncher.profiles.markdownDescription:
One status bar button per profile. **[Manage profiles](command:claudeLauncher.manageProfiles)** to add, rename, recolor, or remove them without editing JSON.

`configDir` sets `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` for that profile (e.g. `~/.claude-work`); leave it out for the default `~/.claude`. Names must be unique.

name.description: Label shown on the status bar button, e.g. "Personal" or "Work".

configDir.description: Value for CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, e.g. ~/.claude-work. Leave empty for the default ~/.claude.

color.description: Tints this profile's status bar button and terminal tab, using your theme's terminal colors.

claudeLauncher.defaultProfile.markdownDescription: Name of the profile this workspace uses. When set, only that profile's button is shown, and the keyboard shortcut and commands use it without asking. **[Pick one for this project](command:claudeLauncher.setProjectProfile)**, or set it in **Workspace** settings, e.g. `Work` for work repos.

claudeLauncher.crossProfileMessaging.markdownDescription: Let Claude sessions in the same project talk to each other across profiles (e.g. a Work agent messaging a Personal one). Agents get `list_peers` and `send_message` tools, and incoming messages are handed to them between steps. **Claude: Open Live Chat** adds a session that receives messages instantly through Claude Code channels (research preview). Messages stay within the project. **[Toggle for this project](command:claudeLauncher.toggleCrossProfileMessaging)**

claudeLauncher.openOnStartup.markdownDescription: Open the agents tab automatically when a window opens. Needs a single-folder workspace and a profile it can pick without asking: `#claudeLauncher.defaultProfile#`, or your only profile.
